description: This file contains macro definitions for byte and word conversions used in cryptographic operations, specifically for handling big-endian encoding/decoding of integers in the BoringSSL library.

methods.name: n2ln
methods.description: Macro to convert bytes to two 32-bit integers (l1, l2) from a byte pointer c, with variable byte length n.

methods.name: l2nn
methods.description: Macro to convert two 32-bit integers (l1, l2) into bytes at pointer c, with variable byte length n.

methods.name: l2n
methods.description: Macro to encode a 32-bit integer l into 4 bytes at pointer c in big-endian order.

methods.name: n2l
methods.description: Macro to decode 4 bytes from pointer c into a 32-bit integer l in big-endian order.
